config.uiLanguage: UI language for RShell panels and prompts. Reload the window after changing. VS Code command/view labels follow the VS Code display language.
config.localDirectoryMode: Local directory used each time a file transfer window opens. Workspace mode selects the active file’s local project folder, or the first local workspace folder. Falls back to the user home directory when unavailable.
config.localDirectory: Absolute local directory for custom mode. Supports ~ for the user home directory. Applies to newly opened transfer windows.
